description: Your personal shopper: search the shops you like all at once, compare their products side by side on one screen, keep a cart across shops, and let Iris get the order ready at each checkout.

slash.shopper: search your shops and see the cart

texts.noBridge: This screen cannot reach the shopper here. Ask Iris instead.
texts.whyNoSearch: no open search, add its products by link
texts.whyNotSelling: sells nothing through its web shop
texts.howFilled: Opens the shop's own checkout with everything already in it.
texts.howCart: Puts it in the shop's cart.
texts.howSteps: Open each product to put it in the shop's cart, then pay.
texts.howPage: This shop has no cart link; order it on the product page.
texts.empty: Tell Iris what you are looking for, and the products of every shop you follow appear here.
texts.exampleSay1: Find me a warm wool sweater under 100 euro
texts.exampleSay2: Which shops do I follow for shopping?
texts.readyToPay: Ready. Open each shop, check the order and pay on its own page.
texts.sureText: Iris opens each shop's checkout with everything in it. You pay there; nothing is paid here.
texts.nothingKept: Nothing kept yet. Tap Keep on a product to decide later.
texts.title: Personal shopper
texts.subtitle: Every shop you like, in one place
texts.askCart: What is in my shopping cart?
